CreateDeployment.document: This API is used to create a deployment. When uploading an artifact, pass Upload for ViaMeta and Provider, and pass the path of the uploaded object for TempBucketPath.
CreateDeployment.name: Create deployment

CreateProject.document: This API is used to create a project. When uploading an artifact, pass Upload for Provider and Custom for Channel.
CreateProject.name: Creates a project

CreateZoneCustomDomain.document: Bind a custom domain name to a specified environment of a project.
CreateZoneCustomDomain.name: Binds a custom domain

DeleteProject.document: Delete a project. In-progress builds prevent deletion.
DeleteProject.name: Deletes a project

DeleteProjectCustomDomains.document: Unbind a custom domain name from a project by domain name.
DeleteProjectCustomDomains.name: Deletes a custom domain name of a project

DeleteProjectEnvs.document: Delete environment variables by EnvVars. Match by Id or Key. Value is required but not used for matching. You can pass any value.
DeleteProjectEnvs.name: Deletes environment variables of a project

DescribeCosTempToken.document: Get the COS bucket, region, target path, and temporary key for uploading artifacts.
DescribeCosTempToken.name: Obtains a temporary key for upload

DescribeDeploymentLog.document: Return the access address of the build log.
DescribeDeploymentLog.name: Gets deployment logs

DescribeDeployments.document: Query deployment records of a project.
DescribeDeployments.name: Retrieves the deployment record list

DescribeEnvironments.document: Query environments in a project, including built-in Production, Preview, and custom environments.
DescribeEnvironments.name: Queries the environment list

DescribeProjectEnvs.document: Query project environment variables. If Env is not specified, return all application scopes.
DescribeProjectEnvs.name: Obtains environment variables of a project

DescribeProjects.document: This API is used to query projects under a site by page. Offset is the page number offset, and the backend skips Offset * Limit items.
DescribeProjects.name: Obtains the user project list

DescribeZoneCustomDomains.document: Queries the custom and preset domain names of a project under a site.
DescribeZoneCustomDomains.name: Queries a custom domain name

ModifyProject.document: Modify the project name and build configuration. Fields not passed retain their original values.
ModifyProject.name: Edits basic project information

ModifyProjectEnvs.document: Write environment variables based on the passed-in EnvVars.
ModifyProjectEnvs.name: Edits environment variables of a project

ModifyZoneCustomDomainEnv.document: Switch a bound custom domain name to another environment.
ModifyZoneCustomDomainEnv.name: Modifies the custom domain environment
